About this page

A monthly look at hiring activity for Broomfield's major employers — Ball Corporation, Noodles & Company, Vail Resorts. Review-theme summaries and star ratings are temporarily withheld (see below).

How this works: this page used to summarize recurring themes from public Glassdoor/Indeed search-result snippets (never a verbatim quote, always attributed to what reviews say). Both the review-theme summaries and star ratings/rankings are temporarily withheld while we review Glassdoor's and Indeed's own terms of use on republishing their content -- the search-result text itself routinely restates a specific numeric rating, so hiding the rating column alone wasn't enough. Hiring data below (sourced from Adzuna, a separate, unrelated source) is unaffected.

Hiring column: a count of job postings for that employer observed via the Adzuna job board in the last 30 days — not a real-time "openings now" figure, and never a hiring, headcount, or growth claim. Some employers show 0: that's a real absence of Adzuna listings for that company today, not a missing measurement.
